changelog: **Employer self-signup (#1865, part 2):** `/for-companies/signup` → `POST /api/public/signup/company` (internship hosts only; per-IP rate limit, honeypot + min fill time answered with the same 202, free-mail domains refused as `free_mail_domain`). `provisionSelfSignupCompany()` creates a PENDING company (with `signupDomain`) and its COMPANY invitation in one transaction; the invitation's sender is null (`CreateInvitationInput.actor.id` may now be null), the set-password link is mailed and never returned, and a taken address answers the same 202. Admins are told via `notifyEvent('signup.companySelf')`. Domain-proof fast path: `GET /api/company/onboarding` gives a PENDING company its `interncrm-verification=<HMAC>` TXT record and `POST /api/company/onboarding/domain-proof` checks the stored `signupDomain` and flips PENDING → VERIFIED (guarded, audited, `verifiedById` null; never overrides REJECTED/SUSPENDED). Onboarding card on `/company` with a checklist derived from live data, and `/company/profile` where a COMPANY user edits its six fields. Pure rules in `src/lib/companySignup.ts`, unit-tested.

en: Employers can now sign up on their own from the For companies page. New accounts are verified before candidates see them — by the programme team, or instantly with a DNS record on the company domain — and a getting-started card guides them through their profile and first role.
tr: İşverenler artık Şirketler için sayfasından kendileri kaydolabiliyor. Yeni hesaplar adaylara görünmeden önce doğrulanıyor — program ekibi tarafından ya da şirket alan adına eklenen bir DNS kaydıyla anında — ve bir başlangıç kartı profil ve ilk pozisyon adımlarında yol gösteriyor.
de: Arbeitgeber können sich jetzt selbst über die Seite „Für Unternehmen“ registrieren. Neue Konten werden verifiziert, bevor Kandidat:innen sie sehen – durch das Programmteam oder sofort per DNS-Eintrag auf der Firmendomain –, und eine Startkarte führt durch Profil und erste Stelle.
